resources.string: Kaivor uses Accessibility only to run tasks you send from your own Telegram chat — tap, type, and scroll in apps on your phone. Open source. No cloud server. Your screen data stays on this device.

Automation apps need Accessibility, which Google flags as sensitive. Kaivor is open source, runs only on your device, and never asks for contacts, call logs, or access to all apps. Tap More details, then Install anyway.
